notes_for_editor: No build date, builder, staffing, fires or condition after 1991 appear in any source found. Open question: the 1948 report describes a planned move from Sikes, and the 1971 NGS record places a Sikes Lookout Tower at the site; no source says whether the move happened or whether the tower was replaced. NGS text ties the 110 feet to the observation cabin, so 33.5 m is the cabin-stated height and should be checked before publishing as tower height. The tnlandforms entry 'Sikes Observation Tower (historical)' is unexplained and may not be the 1948 tower. Not listed on the Wikipedia list, NHLR or FFLOS. The NGS sheet says photographs may exist for the station; none were captured. No access or agency data found, so none recorded.
